name: USA Injection Molding
old_description: USA Injection’s parent company, LMT Mercer Group, Inc., was formed in 1987 to supply the fence and deck industry with high-quality component parts. Today, we are the largest manufacturer of fence, deck and railing accessories to the US and Canada with more than 950 products.  Additionally, we now serve all industries that use plastic injection molding products and components.  We manufacture a broad range of products designed to meet the needs of a diverse and demanding customer base, introducing at least twenty (20) new products each year.
about:
USA Injection Molding operates as a division of LMT Mercer Group, Inc., which was founded in 1987 to supply component parts to the fence and deck industry. Headquartered in Lawrenceville, New Jersey, the company has grown into a full-service custom plastic injection molding facility with manufacturing plants in New Jersey and Ohio and distribution centers in New Jersey, Ohio, and Nevada.

The company provides end-to-end services from product design and mold making through injection molding, assembly, packaging, and fulfillment. It runs 36 injection molding machines ranging from 60 to 1,000 tons, equipped with servo-robotics and nitrogen gas-assist, and builds nearly 100 new molds each year — from single-cavity prototypes to 64-cavity high-production tools. More than 50 certified resins are stocked in-house, including PVC, nylon, polyethylene, and polycarbonate, supported by an internal material testing lab and rapid prototyping capability.

USA Injection Molding serves a broad range of sectors, including medical, military and defense, personal care, building and construction, housewares, cosmetics, agriculture, vinyl fence and railing, appliances, automotive, commercial food packaging, electronics, office products, and wood composite decking. Its original customer base was the fence and deck industry, where it now offers over 950 accessory products and introduces at least 20 new items annually.

The company emphasizes its U.S.-based manufacturing, in-house tooling and engineering, rapid prototyping printed in hours, and a three-warehouse distribution network as key differentiators. Its stated mission is to lead the industry in design, manufacturing, and distribution of plastic injection molding products by setting benchmarks for quality, service, and competitive pricing.
